title: View an interrupted past action
instructions: Use the time relationship to choose the verb form.

parts.prompt: The science club ___ the water samples when the power failed.

choice_rationales.A: Present perfect does not fit the finished past interruption marked by failed.
choice_rationales.B: Was testing presents the longer action as already in progress when the power failed.
choice_rationales.C: Simple present would describe a routine, not the action in progress at this past moment.
choice_rationales.D: Future time contradicts the completed past event.

parts.hint: Decide which action was already in progress when the shorter event happened.
parts.correct_explanation: The testing was in progress at the moment the power failed, so past continuous is required.
